trees.name: Blade
trees.description: Swords, axes and polearms. Hit harder, strike critical wounds, and drink life from your foes.

trees.name: Powder
trees.description: Pistols, muskets and blunderbusses. Faster reloads, steadier aim and shots that end fights.

trees.name: Survivor
trees.description: Outlast the dungeons. More health and stamina, a hardy body and a mind that will not break.

perks.name: Keen Edge
perks.description: +6% melee damage per rank.

perks.name: Iron Guard
perks.description: Blocked hits deal 8% less damage and cost 15% less stamina per rank.

perks.name: Bloodletter
perks.description: +5% critical chance with melee weapons per rank.

perks.name: Whirlwind
perks.description: Ability: spin with your blade and hit everything around you.

perks.name: Butcher's Mark
perks.description: +15% critical damage per rank.

perks.name: Lunge
perks.description: Ability: dash forward and run your enemy through.

perks.name: Bloodthirst
perks.description: Melee hits heal you for 4% of the damage dealt per rank.

perks.name: Duelist's Grace
perks.description: Swing 12% faster. Every kill gives back 15 stamina.

perks.name: Steady Hands
perks.description: -12% shot spread and +5% firearm damage per rank.

perks.name: Quick Loader
perks.description: Reload 10% faster per rank.

perks.name: Powder Thrift
perks.description: 15% chance per rank that a reload uses no powder and shot.

perks.name: Dead-Eye
perks.description: Ability: your next shot flies true and is a critical hit for double damage.

perks.name: Heavy Ball
perks.description: +12% firearm damage per rank.

perks.name: Smoke and Thunder
perks.description: Ability: a burst of black powder that burns and stuns every creature near you.

perks.name: Hunter's Eye
perks.description: +4% critical chance with every weapon per rank.

perks.name: Executioner
perks.description: +50% damage against wounded enemies (below 30% health), with any weapon.

perks.name: Thick Skin
perks.description: +12 max health per rank.

perks.name: Iron Lungs
perks.description: +10 max stamina and +6% stamina regeneration per rank.

perks.name: Forager's Gut
perks.description: You get hungry and thirsty 12% slower per rank.

perks.name: Second Wind
perks.description: Ability: catch your breath. Heal 35% of your health, refill stamina and ease poison.

perks.name: Cold Blood
perks.description: Freezing cold and furnace heat affect you 20% less per rank. Armor wears 10% slower per rank.

perks.name: Unbroken Mind
perks.description: Insanity builds 15% slower and poison bites 10% less per rank.

perks.name: Battle Cry
perks.description: Ability: a roar that stuns nearby creatures. For a while you deal 20% more damage and take 25% less.

perks.name: Last Stand
perks.description: Once between sleeps, a killing blow leaves you at 1 health and untouchable for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Whirlwind
abilities.description: Hit every creature around you for 140% damage.

abilities.name: Lunge
abilities.description: Dash 6 m forward and strike for 180% damage. You can't be hit while lunging.

abilities.name: Dead-Eye
abilities.description: For 8 seconds your next shot has no spread and is a critical hit for x2 damage.

abilities.name: Smoke and Thunder
abilities.description: Burn every creature within 7 m for 25 damage and stun them for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Second Wind
abilities.description: Heal 35% of max health, refill stamina and halve poison.

abilities.name: Battle Cry
abilities.description: Stun creatures within 8 m for 1.5 s. For 12 s: +20% damage, -25% damage taken.
